title: Canonical maps and interfaces of reconstructed refinement coherence
statement: Under the primes, finite coefficient extension, geometric and comparison-family hypotheses of [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization], use the supplied Brown representing data of [lem-pur-integral-reconstructed-representing-pair]. The original support, comparison, At, supplied object, counit and trace, coordinate conjugation, systemDown, systemComparison, mate, reconstructedMap, realization and scalar trace functors, Equations, common comparisons and Coherence are retained verbatim. In particular comparison is the inverse of actual integralRefinement, systemDown is the five-factor conjugation of actual systemRefinement, mate is the inverse Brown Hom image of the forward system comparison followed by the second counit, and reconstructedMap is actual total limit. Equations records integral counit and Hom, scalar, field, closure and adjunction transpose conclusions. Coherence records identity, composition, common-refinement independence, cocycles, reduction, Brown mate, supplied-pair, common-degree and scalar laws as conclusions, never assumptions. This node only extracts the pre-existing interfaces and already-proved invertibility/origin helpers, without changing any declaration.

proof.text: The interface definitions are copied verbatim from the parent module. The retained systemDown_isIso proof applies finite-origin evaluation to the actual normalized refinement, uses conservative evaluation to prove invertibility, then transports it by coordinate conjugation. The retained output_origin proof transfers the intrinsic origin witness between the normalized site packages using the derived equivalence factorization and the Brown boundedness theorem. No new data or unproved choices are introduced.
